title: [spec-bug][R-ADR-002] appendix-design-rationale.md:107-110 SCHC sizes 18/32-33 bytes and native-address wording stale vs 03-adaptation.md (23/37, Yggdrasil)
description: spec/appendix-design-rationale.md:107-110 says the baseline compresses link-local IPv6+UDP to 18 bytes and native-address IPv6+UDP to 32-33 bytes. Normative spec/03-adaptation.md section 5.3/5.5 states 23 bytes (link-local Rule 0) and 37 bytes (Yggdrasil Rule 1) for IPv6+UDP+CoAP; the word native appears nowhere in 03-adaptation.md or appendix-schc.md (rg zero), and the SHA-512 native address profile is exactly what the settled upstream-yggdrasil-addressing decision (spec/decisions.jsonl) rejected. spec/appendix-misc.md:38 hedges with 18-33 bytes. Found during appendix-design-rationale sweep. Suggested fix: reword appendix 3.2 to 23/37 bytes with Yggdrasil terminology (or state pure IPv6+UDP figures if 18/32-33 were pre-CoAP numbers); align appendix-misc.md.
close_reason: Reworded appendix-design-rationale.md 3.2 to normative 23/37-byte Rule 0/Rule 1 figures with Yggdrasil terminology (was stale 18/32-33 'native-address'); aligned appendix-misc.md Header Overhead row to 23-37. Verified against spec/03-adaptation.md 5.3 (Rule 0 link-local IPv6+UDP+CoAP = 23 B, Rule 1 Yggdrasil = 37 B) and appendix-schc.md derivation; rg confirms no stale 18/32-33/18-33 figures remain in spec/ outside the two follow-up beads. 3x codereview delegated to kimi-k3 (correctness PASS; security 1 pre-existing finding -> hezw; edge-cases 3 residual stale-figure findings -> v03v P2, bijq P3). Diff touched only the two named spec files.
